# Rido — Shared E-Scooters & E-Bikes on the Costa del Sol

Rido is a shared e-scooter and e-bike micro-mobility service launching on the Costa del Sol, Spain. The service will provide zero-emission shared vehicles available via a mobile app. Users will find, unlock, ride and park vehicles using the Rido app.

Operated by Go2 Place S.L. (NIF B01745405), based in Orihuela Costa, Alicante, Spain. Built and operated by a local Costa del Sol team.

## Hero Section

**Headline**: Move Freely Across the Costa del Sol

**Subheadline**: Cheaper than a taxi, cleaner than a rental car, and run by people who live in your city. Built and operated by a local Costa del Sol team — every euro stays here.

**Stats**: 5 Planned Cities | 2 Vehicle Types | Zero Direct Emissions

**Badge**: Coming soon to the Costa del Sol

---

## How It Works

### Step 1: Sign Up Early
Join the waitlist now and be first in line when the Rido app launches. Create your account in seconds when it's ready.

### Step 2: Scan & Unlock
Find a Rido nearby on the map, scan the QR code on the handlebar, and you're ready to roll.

### Step 3: Ride & Enjoy
Follow traffic rules and use bike lanes. A helmet is included with every scooter and is mandatory for e-scooter riders in Spain from 1 October 2026.

### Step 4: Park & End Ride
Park responsibly in designated areas shown in the app. End your ride and pay only for what you used.

---

## Vehicles

### Rido Scooter (E-Scooter)
- **Tagline**: Glide through the city
- **Description**: Our top-tier e-scooter with a wide deck, powerful brakes, and up to 45 km of range. Built for urban explorers who demand safety and style.
- **Range**: 45 km
- **Top Speed**: 25 km/h
- **Weight Limit**: 120 kg
- **Battery**: Swappable
- **Features**: Helmet provided; DGT-compliant hardware for Spain's 2026 VMP rules; registered fleet with ID sticker; civil liability insurance included; anti-tampering motor, 25 km/h by design; front and rear lights + brake light + reflectors; dual brakes (front + rear); ≥203 mm puncture-resistant wheels; turn signals; beginner mode (15 km/h); GPS tracking & geofencing

### Rido Bike (E-Bike)
- **Tagline**: Pedal further, effort less
- **Description**: Our electric-assist bike with smooth pedal support, an adjustable saddle, and a sturdy front basket. Perfect for longer commutes and carrying essentials.
- **Range**: 60 km
- **Assist Speed**: 25 km/h
- **Weight Limit**: 130 kg
- **Battery**: Swappable
- **Features**: Electric pedal assist, adjustable saddle height, front cargo basket, integrated lights, puncture-resistant tyres, step-through frame design, civil liability insurance included

## Cities

Launch towns on the Costa del Sol will be announced soon. The service area is the Costa del Sol (Málaga province, Andalusia).

---

## Safety

Rido's e-scooter fleet is being prepared to meet Spain's new VMP regulation (DGT), in force from 1 October 2026: certified vehicles, registration with an identification sticker, civil liability insurance and an anti-tampering motor limited to 25 km/h.

### Helmet Included — Required by Law
A helmet is included with every scooter. From 1 October 2026 helmet use is mandatory for e-scooter riders across Spain.

### One Rider Only
One scooter, one rider. Our tandem detection system ensures nobody doubles up.

### Stay Sober
No riding under the influence. At peak hours, a cognitive reaction test may be required to unlock.

### Park Responsibly
Park in designated areas shown in the app. Keep sidewalks clear for pedestrians and accessibility.

---

## Sustainability

Every Rido ride is designed to replace a car trip. Audited impact figures will be published after the first year of operation; no projections are claimed.

### Commitments
- **Carbon-neutral operations**: We plan to offset operational emissions through verified carbon credits and green energy.
- **Swappable batteries**: Vehicle batteries are swappable and recycled at end of life. No single-use waste.
- **Responsible recycling**: At end of life, every vehicle is dismantled and recycled.

---

## Pricing

Fares will be announced at launch. Planned plans: Pay as you go, Rido Pass (subscription), Day Pass. Exact pricing is always shown in the app before every ride.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What age do I need to be to ride a Rido?
You must be at least 18 years old to ride a Rido e-scooter or e-bike. You'll need to verify your age when creating an account in the app.

### How do I find and unlock a Rido vehicle?
Open the Rido app, find a vehicle near you on the map, scan the QR code on the handlebar, and you're ready to ride. The app shows real-time availability and battery levels.

### Do I need a driver's licence?
No licence is required in Spain for e-scooters limited to 25 km/h (personal mobility vehicles) or for pedal-assist e-bikes. Riders must be at least 18 to use Rido.

### Can I ride in bike lanes?
Yes. In Spain, e-scooters and e-bikes are permitted in bike lanes and on roads with speed limits up to 30 km/h. Always avoid pavements and pedestrian zones.

### Where do I park when I'm done?
Park in designated areas shown in the app. These are typically bike rack zones or marked parking areas. Keep pavements clear for pedestrians and accessibility.

### Do I need to wear a helmet?
Yes for e-scooters: from 1 October 2026 helmet use is mandatory for e-scooter riders across Spain. We include a helmet with every scooter. We strongly recommend one on e-bikes too.

### How much does it cost?
Fares will be announced at launch. Exact pricing is always shown in the app before you start a ride.

### What if the battery dies during my ride?
Our app shows real-time battery levels so you can choose a fully charged vehicle. If a battery runs low during your ride, you can end it at any designated parking area — no extra charge.

### Is my ride insured?
Yes, every Rido ride includes civil liability insurance, as required for VMP in Spain. For full details, see our Terms of Service.

---

## About Rido

Rido was founded with a simple belief: coastal towns deserve better air and easier short trips.

So we are building a fleet of shared e-scooters and e-bikes designed for the Costa del Sol's streets, weather and people. Vehicles are serviced in our own workshops, every ride is insured, and every kilometre is designed to replace a car trip.

### Milestones
- 2025: Rido founded in Spain
- 2026: Costa del Sol launch — 5 towns planned
- 2027: Expanding across Andalusia

### Values
- **Freedom**: Move on your terms. No schedules, no waiting, no parking headaches. Just scan and go.
- **Safety**: Beginner mode, tandem detection, brake checks, and real-time ride monitoring.
- **Sustainability**: Zero emissions, swappable batteries, responsible recycling.

---

## Partners

Run Rido in your city: turn-key shared mobility for Spanish towns. Rido brings the certified fleet, the rider app, insurance and the operations playbook; the partner brings the local team. Enquiries: info@rido.bike.
